sermon.title: What Is the Next Step After…
sermon.series: Bible Morality Banned by Wimps and Born by Warriors
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message, Part 4 of his Bible morality series, the speaker says what is added to faith after the Holy Spirit is virtue, moral excellent behavior with the courage to do it, from 2 Peter 1. He says a justice system should punish those who harm others, reads Romans 13, Proverbs 21:11 and Isaiah 5:20, compares today’s opponents to the Pharisees, and speaks about religious freedom and the Bible in early America.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. The recording does not state the speaker’s name; the “Bible morality” theme matches Pastor Kincer’s other messages, but his name is not spoken, so Michael should confirm. The title on YouTube is “What is the Next Step After…” and the series name and “part four” come from the speaker’s opening words. Editor notes: he says “Mark 11:27 and 12:23” where the Pharisees and Herodians are sent to Jesus in Mark 12:13; he cites “Proverbs 21 11” and “Romans 13 1-6.” Captions garbled “by [unclear] except by Beelzebub,” and “First Amendment,” “Pharisees and Herodians,” “Stephen” and “recruit” are caption corrections. This message is political: it covers government and punishment, the First Amendment, the Bible and Congress in the 1770s, other religions’ books, and remarks about “wimps,” “bashers” and “bullies.” His historical and constitutional statements are his own and are not verified here.
